summary: The ask is answered on the PAGES. The unnumbered vol-10 extra 「ベルベル☆西遊記〜天竺までぶっとばせ!!〜」 is FIVE story pages (MangaDex numbers it 88.5 in vol 10; the EN and pt-BR uploads are 6 files, page 1 being the scanlation credit page — I read all six: page 2 opens 'SPECIAL SIDE STORY, BEEL BEEL☆"SAIYUKI". LET'S HEAD TOWARDS TENJIKU!!' and page 6 closes 'BEEL BEEL☆"SAIYUKI" IS OVER'). Its entire content is: (a) the desert journey to Tenjiku with Oga=Sanzo on a camel, Beel=Goku, Furuichi=Cho Hakkai, Kunieda=Sa Gojo, and Oga demanding to be called Master Priest; (b) a 'village girl' begging for help who is a disguise — Himekawa=Kinkaku and Kanzaki=Ginkaku, Ginkaku holding the double-bulb GOURD, Kinkaku a bottle, with the underage-drinking gag and Kunieda's outburst; (c) Oga dropkicking both ('REST IN PIECES!!!') and asking where India is; (d) ONE closing panel teasing the Ox Demon Lord complaining 'they're late'. That is the whole source. Now the episode, from the LICENSOR's own per-episode synopsis (YTV, the production station, /beelze/back/bn05.html, バブ49): beats 1-2 are exactly (a) and (b) — 「男鹿三蔵法師は、ベル坊孫悟空、沙悟浄邦枝、猪八戒古市をお供に天竺を目指して旅をしておりました」 and 「名前を呼ばれた者を吸い込み…ひょうたんを持つ、姫川金角と神崎銀角の２人をはじめ、様々な魔物に命を狙われていた」 (the gourd is on the page). Every beat after that is outside the source: the Shiroyama village and its 村長 reporting the Ox King gang's misdeeds; Oga deciding to go to the Ox King's castle ('俺より強い奴に会いに行く'); the Six Holy Knights and the Red Tails joining the march; En cast as 紅孩児 waiting for playmates; the New Year's 大カルタ大会; En crying over a lost card and setting the place ablaze; the Bashō fan only the Ox King holds; and (beelzebub.fandom's summary) Tojo's takoyaki side-job, the fire put out, the takoyaki party that ends the episode with the quest forgotten. So the source is the episode's FIRST ACT — its premise, its cast roles and one fully resolved conflict — and the episode's own JOB, the New Year's party at the Ox King's castle, is not in the source at all. Under T28 that is MIXED, not canon: the extra chapter is emphatically NOT 'the plot with the novel only lengthening it'. It is also not filler: the source segment is a first-time, sole-adaptation scene sequence (no other episode animates 88.5 — ep 42 starts at ch 88 and the catalog's coverage set holds no other claim), so weight SIGNIFICANT, not sliver. FURTHER FINDING beyond the ask: the non-source body is not demonstrably the NOVEL's either. ja-WP's 登場人物 page documents the novel's actual plot — a sealed 邪神 lost from the demon-world castle storeroom, mixed into Hilda's 「よいこのえほん」, appearing in the Saiyuki world as the 紅葫蘆, rewriting Hilda's personality into 羅刹女, swallowing Oga AND Tojo, destroyed by the 魔王の咆哮 from inside and out — and NONE of that airs. ja-WP's novel role list (男鹿三蔵法師/ベル坊孫悟空/古市猪八戒/葵沙悟浄/ラミア観世音菩薩/神崎銀角/姫川金角/東条牛魔王/ヒルダ羅刹女) has no En and the episode has no Lamia. So a large share of what airs is most likely anime-original rather than novel. Under T26 this changes nothing for the type (novel-only and anime-original are both NON-SOURCE), but it means the stored side_source note ('the novel supplies the episode's actual plot') over-credits the novel and should be replaced. No anchor (A44, stored and correct — the extra carries no number in the 1-252 space); no continue moves; no dates or titles wrong.

type_corrections.note: RETYPE canon → mixed. T26 removed the prop the stored canon rested on: the batch-21 wave-2 pin was written when the licensed novel still conferred standing ('CONFIRMED AS STORED by chapter accounting'), and with the novel out the row's standing rests on its MANGA share alone. Segment accounting, T28. SEGMENT 1 — the source: the whole of the unnumbered vol-10 extra 「ベルベル☆西遊記〜天竺までぶっとばせ!!〜」, 5 pages, animated as the episode's opening act — the desert march to Tenjiku with Oga=Sanzo / Beel=Goku / Furuichi=Cho Hakkai / Kunieda=Sa Gojo, the disguised 'village girl', the Himekawa=Kinkaku and Kanzaki=Ginkaku ambush with the gourd, and Oga's dropkick that ends it. weight: SIGNIFICANT — it is a scene sequence that progresses the episode's story (it launches the journey and resolves a named conflict), it establishes every role the rest of the episode plays out, and it is a SOLE ADAPTATION: no other episode animates these pages (ep 41 ends at printed ch 87, ep 42 starts at 88, and the extra sits between 88 and 89 with no other claim in the coverage set). Not a sliver: not a tease, not framing panels, not material adapted properly elsewhere. SEGMENT 2 — non-source: everything after that act, which is the episode's actual job — the Shiroyama village and its chief, the decision to seek the Ox King, the Six Holy Knights / Red Tails / MK5 / all-of-Ishiyama march, En as 紅孩児, the New Year's karuta tournament, En's tantrum and the fire, the Bashō fan and Tojo's takoyaki party. weight: SIGNIFICANT, and NON-SOURCE whether it comes from the novel or from the studio (T26: a licence is not adoption; and the novel's own documented plot — the 邪神 in the picture book, Hilda rewritten into 羅刹女, Oga and Tojo swallowed, the 魔王の咆哮 — does not air, so much of it is probably anime-original). A recap sits inside the framing and is WEIGHTLESS (T28 recap clause). Source + non-source in one episode, the source share story-carrying = MIXED. Canon fails the ask's own test — the extra chapter is not 'the plot with the novel only lengthening it'; it is the first act of an episode whose plot the source does not contain. Filler fails too — the source segment is significant, first-time and sole. The stored T6 pin {"49":"canon"} needs to become mixed or be lifted; A44 [49] is unaffected and no anchor is delivered.

structure.notes: THE ASK'S PREMISE HELD, WITH ONE ADDITION. The ask framed the episode as a two-way split between the extra chapter (source) and 'the novel-only expansion' (non-source). The extra-chapter half is exactly as framed and is now measured on the pages. The other half is NOT demonstrably the novel's: ja-WP's 登場人物 page documents the novel's plot as a sealed 邪神 that entered Hilda's picture book, took the form of the 紅葫蘆, rewrote Hilda into 羅刹女, swallowed Oga and Tojo and was killed by the 魔王の咆哮 — a plot the episode does not contain — and the novel's role list has no En while the episode's cast has no Lamia (the novel's 観世音菩薩). The episode instead casts En, the character the anime had just finished a 10-episode arc on (eps 38-48), as 紅孩児, the Ox King's son. So the honest reading of the non-source half is: the novel's PREMISE and some role assignments, plus a substantial anime-original body. Under T26 the type is unaffected (both are non-source), which is why this is a structure note and not a second type argument. WHAT I COULD NOT VERIFY: the novel's interior chapter list. shueisha.co.jp's item page carries the blurb, page count and credits but no 目次; the novel is out of print with no digital edition and no accessible review that walks its chapters; searches returned only instant-answer restatements of ja-WP (cross-check only, not cited). The claim I could not test is therefore 'which non-source beats are the novel's and which are the studio's' — and it does not bear on the verdict. SOURCE HYGIENE: animefillerguide's Beelzebub page did not respond during this session (0 bytes, two attempts); it would not have been a type witness in any case — the trap note on this series records its old format with 'SPECIAL' in ch 49's chapter cell, and AFL + AFG are one lineage. ja-WP's 各話リスト bold/footnote is one source, used only as attribution evidence in the side_source note, never as the type witness. The four sources carrying the verdict are independent: the manga's own pages, the broadcaster's synopsis, the English wiki's summary, and ja-WP's character/novel documentation. ROW-COUNT IDENTITY: ja-WP's 各話リスト, YTV's back-number list and beelzebub.fandom all number this row 49 with air date 2012-01-08 and the same title, so no join risk; YTV's bn05 covers 41-50 and the title/date match is exact.
